title: Representation-Matched q-Sensitivity: Reproducibility Archive
description: Public reproducibility archive supporting the manuscript 'Representation-Matched q-Sensitivity: Rank Reversal and Decision Robustness in q-Rung Orthopair Fuzzy Models'. It contains seven executable benchmark reconstructions, Qin/He verification code, retained radius-certificate assets, directed-rounding verification, derived numeric records, and provenance files. The exact global winner-reversal radius is not claimed.
